qualified_questions.question: [Simple] What games does a player play?
qualified_questions.sparql_query:
PREFIX VideoGameOntology: <http://example.org/VideoGameOntology#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?player ?game
WHERE {
  ?player VideoGameOntology:playsGame ?game .
}

qualified_questions.question: [Simple] Which characters are in a specific game?
qualified_questions.sparql_query:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX VideoGameOntology: <http://example.org/VideoGameOntology#>

SELECT ?character
WHERE {
  ?character VideoGameOntology:isCharacterInGame ?game .
  FILTER (?game = <http://example.org/VideoGameOntology#SpecificGame>)
}

qualified_questions.question: [Complex] Which players, who are friends with each other, have played the same game?
qualified_questions.sparql_query:
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX VideoGameOntology: <http://example.org/VideoGameOntology#>

SELECT ?player1 ?player2 ?game
WHERE {
  ?player1 a VideoGameOntology:Player .
  ?player2 a VideoGameOntology:Player .
  ?player1 foaf:knows ?player2 .
  ?player2 foaf:knows ?player1 .
  ?player1 VideoGameOntology:playsGame ?game .
  ?player2 VideoGameOntology:playsGame ?game .
  FILTER(?player1 != ?player2)
}
